generation.scope: All distinct opposite quadratic matrices on all finite Frobenius windows have nonzero determinant, without any assumptions on multiplicities or support. The remaining Gram pencil forces a length-four Frobenius algebra and a grid of two disjoint length-two divisors of the isotropic conic. The reduced grid and both nonreduced grids contradict injective cubic evaluation. Consequently octic-free finite edges have at most one standard regular extension, with a finite existence test across all components.

open_mathematics: Use the universal nonzero triple octic to reconstruct all possible distinct opposite roots in further strata and decide regularity beyond the existing finite criteria. The unrestricted positive-dimensional branches and global specialization classification also remain open.
